meta.title: PiPixiv — Open-source, cross-platform Pixiv client
meta.description: PiPixiv is an open-source third-party Pixiv client written entirely in Compose Multiplatform, available for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux. Illustrations, ugoira, manga, novels and AI novel translation in one app.
meta.ogTitle: PiPixiv — Explore Pixiv on every screen

title: Explore {pixiv}
on every screen
hero.lead: PiPixiv is an open-source third-party Pixiv client written entirely in Compose Multiplatform. Illustrations, ugoira, manga and novels feel just as good on your phone, tablet and desktop.

title: Artworks, series and novels
all in one app
features.lead: From your home feed to the rankings, from ugoira to long-form novels, PiPixiv makes every part of browsing Pixiv quick and comfortable.

ranking.title: Recommended, ranked, new
ranking.body: A personalised masonry feed on the home screen and latest works sorted by discovery, bookmarks and follows. Rankings cover daily, weekly, monthly, popular with men and women, original, rookie and AI-generated, including past dates.

illust.title: Illustrations & ugoira
illust.body: Multi-page works and ugoira animations just work. Pick the preview quality, zoom freely, download originals or export GIFs, and batch-download multi-page works with your own file names.

ai.title: AI novel translation
ai.body: Works with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and compatible APIs, including services on your local network. Translations stream in, are cached locally and can be toggled with the original. Read-later items can be queued for translation.

samples.source: 放課後の図書室には、雨の匂いが満ちていた。
samples.output: After school, the library was filled with the smell of rain.

samples.source: 彼女は振り返らずに、小さく手を振った。
samples.output: Without looking back, she gave a small wave.

samples.source: 星の数だけ、物語がある。
samples.output: There are as many stories as there are stars.

reader.title: Immersive novel reader
reader.body: Adjust font size and line spacing, drag the scrollbar to jump around, and keep your place while changing the layout. Progress is saved automatically, series pick up where you left off, and bookmarks and TXT export are built in.

accounts.title: Switch accounts instantly
accounts.body: Add, switch or remove accounts under Settings → Switch account. Browsing history, search history, read-later and reading progress are kept per account.

network.title: Network check
network.body: System proxy, direct connection or manual HTTP / SOCKS proxy, plus ECH on Android and desktop. A built-in check pinpoints what is blocking your connection.

privacy.title: Privacy & blocking
privacy.body: Control R-18 content and clipboard access, block works, users and tags, and filter overly long novel tags. Anonymous usage statistics can be turned off at any time.

search.title: Search & discover
search.body: Search illustrations, novels and users, sort by popularity or date, and filter AI works. Scroll continuously or jump between pages; long-press a tag to bookmark or copy it.

data.title: Your data, your control
data.body: Browsing history stays on your device and can be searched, cleared or pruned automatically. Back up and restore app data, retry pending items after an upgrade, and read local logs anytime.

showcase.title: Just as polished in your hand
showcase.lead: Android and iOS share the same interface, built on Material 3.

ranking.title: Rankings
ranking.body: Daily, weekly, monthly, original, rookie and AI-generated, one swipe apart, plus a calendar for past dates.

detail.title: Artwork details
detail.body: The full image up front, tags with translations, and download, bookmark and share in a floating pill.

novel.title: Novel reader
novel.body: Cover, series, tags and caption at a glance, with translation, contents and bookmarks in the top bar.

settings.title: Liquid glass navigation
settings.body: A floating liquid glass navigation bar, or switch back to the standard bottom bar in Settings.

network.title: Network settings
network.body: Switch between system proxy, direct and manual proxy, and run the network check when something is off. Dark mode included.

bigScreen.title: Big screens get more than a bigger phone
bigScreen.lead: From 600dp the app switches to a navigation rail, and from 840dp the feed and artwork details sit side by side with the full image. The desktop app also works from the keyboard.

search.title: Wide masonry grid
search.body: Search results, rankings and recommendations fill the screen, and the grid column count is adjustable in Settings.

detail.title: Two-pane artwork view
detail.body: The full artwork on the left; artist, translated tags and related works on the right. Download, bookmark and share live in a floating pill.

novel.title: List and reader side by side
novel.body: Novel rankings and the reader sit side by side, with translation, contents and bookmarks in the top bar.

ai.title: Two-pane settings
ai.body: Set the AI translation endpoint, model, timeout and concurrency right next to the settings list.

title: Open source,
engineered with care
opensource.body: PiPixiv is open source under the Apache-2.0 license. A single Kotlin codebase runs on five platforms through Compose Multiplatform. Issues, feature ideas and pull requests are welcome.

items.q: Is PiPixiv an official Pixiv app?
items.a: No. PiPixiv is a community-built, open-source third-party client with no affiliation to pixiv Inc. You sign in with your own Pixiv account, and every artwork belongs to its creator.
No. PiPixiv is free and open source, with its source code on GitHub under the Apache-2.0 license.
Sign in with your Pixiv account (OAuth), or with your web session cookie (PHPSESSID) without copying tokens by hand. Add and switch between accounts under Settings → Switch account.

items.q: How do I install the iOS app?
items.a: Releases include an IPA file, which you install with a sideloading tool such as AltStore or SideStore. iOS 18 or later is required.

items.q: I can't connect to Pixiv. What can I do?
items.a: Under Settings → Network you can switch between system proxy, direct connection and a manual HTTP / SOCKS proxy, use ECH on Android and desktop, or set a custom App API proxy domain. The network check tests DNS, the Pixiv API, the website, login and image downloads one by one to find the problem.

Open an issue on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/darriousliu/PiPixiv/issues). New releases and announcements are posted to the Telegram channel [@PiPixivChannel](https://t.me/PiPixivChannel). Copying the logs from Settings → About → App logs into your report helps a lot.
